failureRecords.summary: Codebase Memory index_repository responses are not bounded at the service boundary.

dispatchPath: registered output serialization only after service completion
rootCause.transportRepresentation: The child JSON-RPC response is parsed as an envelope and value.result is JSON.stringify-ed into the UpstreamTransport Promise<string>; the process transport already rejects an oversized stdout line at 200000 UTF-8 bytes.
rootCause.serviceRepresentation: indexInternal receives the serialized Promise<string> but currently awaits and discards it, then constructs a host index, stores READY state, persists metadata, and returns.
rootCause.canonicalBoundAuthority: CODEBASE_MEMORY_RAW_RESULT_MAX_BYTES plus parseUpstreamResult; do not create a second limit.
rootCause.bypass: Only the index_repository branch in indexInternal skips parseUpstreamResult. Query operations already retain raw text, validate the same bound, parse, normalize, cache, and persist.
rootCause.unsafeEffect: A direct service transport can return an oversized serialized index result and still reach READY metadata publication; the model-facing adapter bound is downstream and cannot repair this service-boundary bypass.

production: Retain the serialized index_repository result at the service boundary.
Invoke the existing parseUpstreamResult validator immediately after transport completion and before READY construction, cache/metadata publication, or any continuation.

Ensure a bounded-result rejection propagates as the existing CODEBASE_MEMORY_UNAVAILABLE error before the failure-persistence branch can publish an index state; preserve ordinary transport failure handling and existing transport limits.
Do not redesign CodebaseMemoryProcessTransport, add another size authority, alter generic tooling, or change external provenance semantics.
tests: Add a deterministic direct-service index_repository fixture whose serialized JSON exceeds CODEBASE_MEMORY_RAW_RESULT_MAX_BYTES and assert rejection, unchanged metadata, no READY event, and no downstream result.
Add the bounded positive control and retain the existing process transport overflow/recovery and registered dispatch tests as regression guards.
Keep the fixture synthetic and do not print or persist raw secret material.

postFixAcceptance: The same ensure-index path rejects oversized serialized output at 200000 UTF-8 bytes with CODEBASE_MEMORY_UNAVAILABLE.
Normalization, cache/metadata publication, authority decisions, READY continuation, and model-facing ToolResult continuation are not reached for the rejected result.
A valid bounded index_repository result still reaches the existing READY path.
The existing process transport bound remains a lower-layer defense and the service bound remains the canonical integration boundary.
mustNotChange: R2-G2-O1, O3, O5, O6, or O7 contract meaning or evidence
agent catalog, skills, MCP, dependencies, or shell permissions

failureRecords.summary: Codebase Memory persistence redacts result excerpts but does not demonstrate redaction of all externally sourced textual metadata such as symbols, relationships, and index/result metadata.

rootCause.unsafePersistenceBoundary: Codebase Memory metadata is written by writeCodebaseMemoryMetadata to .codebase-memory/<workspace-identity-hash>/codebase-memory.json. persistStateSnapshot builds cache[].result immediately before that write.
rootCause.currentRedactionBoundary: redactPersistedResult is called for cache result entries before state serialization, but it maps only excerpts[].text through redactToolText and recomputes excerpt bytes/checksum/totalBytes.

excerpts: text is already redacted; file is currently plan-controlled and line/byte/checksum fields are host-derived
externalFieldsThatCanReachPersistence.optionalImpact: Not populated by the current runQuery normalizer; if populated by the correction surface, apply the same field-level rule before persistence.

production: Expand the existing redactPersistedResult boundary; reuse redactToolText and configured secret values rather than introducing a second redaction engine.
Redact all externally sourced string fields in persisted symbol and relationship data, including nested sourceLocation fields when present; continue redacting excerpt text.
Preserve host-controlled enums, IDs, checksums, line/byte counts, timestamps, workspace/index metadata, and provenance that is host-generated.
Keep the redacted result schema-valid before write; recompute derived excerpt bytes/checksum/totalBytes after redaction and do not invent checksums for unchanged technical fields.
tests: Extend deterministic Codebase Memory persistence coverage with synthetic secret markers in symbol, relationship, and excerpt text fields; assert no marker reaches codebase-memory.json or a restart/cache hit.
Assert ordinary non-secret symbol, relationship, file, signature, and excerpt values remain present to catch over-redaction.
Keep Context7 and shadcn persistence tests byte-for-byte regression guards; they are not correction targets in this plan.

postFixAcceptance: No synthetic secret marker from externally sourced symbol, relationship, nested location, or excerpt text is present in Codebase Memory persisted metadata.
The persisted result remains UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL by its existing provenance/contract semantics.
Normal safe technical metadata and ordinary non-secret external values remain available after restart/cache hit.
The redaction occurs before writeCodebaseMemoryMetadata and before any persistent cache result is published.
mustNotChange: R2-G2-O2 transport or generic ToolResult limits

O2.exactFailure: Codebase Memory index_repository responses are not bounded at the service boundary.
O2.rootCause: indexInternal awaits and discards the serialized index_repository result instead of invoking parseUpstreamResult before READY state and persistence.
O2.preFixProof: A direct service transport returns a syntactically valid serialized result over the canonical byte bound; the frozen implementation incorrectly continues to READY and persists.
correctionSteps: Run parseUpstreamResult at the service boundary before READY construction or publication.
Prevent the bounded-result rejection from entering the failure-persistence publication branch.
Reuse the existing size authority and error taxonomy.
postFixAcceptance: Over-limit index_repository output rejects with CODEBASE_MEMORY_UNAVAILABLE.
Normalization, persistence, and model-facing continuation are not reached.
A bounded valid result remains functional.

o2.dispatchPath: registry -> bound adapter -> service ensureIndex/indexInternal -> process transport -> serialized result -> service validation -> registered output
o2.transportRepresentation: JSON-RPC value.result JSON.stringify-ed to Promise<string>; process stdout line is bounded before completion.
o2.serviceRepresentation: Promise<string> returned by UpstreamTransport; indexInternal currently discards it.
o2.normalizationNotReachedProof: Reject before any index READY/result normalization path; query normalization remains unchanged.
o2.persistenceNotReachedProof: Reject before READY metadata publication for the bounded-result failure; no raw index result is persisted.
o2.positiveBehaviorProof: A bounded syntactically valid index_repository result reaches the existing READY behavior.

O4.exactFailure: Codebase Memory persistence redacts result excerpts but does not demonstrate redaction of externally sourced symbols, relationships, and index/result metadata.
O4.rootCause: redactPersistedResult currently redacts only excerpts[].text; externally sourced symbol and relationship strings pass through to the persisted cache result.
O4.preFixProof: A synthetic secret marker in symbol/relationship/excerpt text is present in the frozen candidate's persisted Codebase Memory metadata.
correctionSteps: Expand the existing redactPersistedResult boundary to all externally sourced result strings.
Reuse redactToolText and configured secret values.
Preserve host technical metadata and recompute excerpt-derived fields.
Validate the persistence DTO before write.
postFixAcceptance: Synthetic external markers are absent from persisted metadata and restart/cache-hit results.
Host technical metadata and ordinary values remain usable.

o4.currentRedactionFunction: redactPersistedResult -> redactToolText; currently complete only for excerpts[].text
o4.currentOrdering: normalize external data -> cache normalized result -> persistStateSnapshot -> redact excerpt copy only -> writeCodebaseMemoryMetadata
o4.requiredOrdering: validate/normalize -> redact every untrusted external persisted string -> schema-validate persistence DTO -> writeCodebaseMemoryMetadata
o4.unsafePersistenceBoundary: The cache[].result value passed into writeCodebaseMemoryMetadata after incomplete redactPersistedResult processing.
o4.canonicalStateBoundary: Host-generated index/identity/currentness/idempotency metadata remains canonical technical state and is not destructively redacted.
o4.secretFixture: Synthetic secret-like markers in symbol, relationship, nested location, and excerpt text; no real credentials.
o4.nonSecretFixture: Ordinary symbol, relationship, file, signature, status, and checksum values remain readable after persistence/restart.
o4.identityCurrentnessImpact: Keep queryId/inputHash/cache key/expiry and host index identity deterministic; never derive identity from a redacted display string.
